input_status: Dimensionless scenario assumptions with measured simulation throughput/work; not verified market costs or field energy savings

measured.selection: PROVISIONAL: one completed nominal development demonstration, not the frozen Monte Carlo study

units.mean_modelled_blower_J: J at assumed 20 W, not measured electrical power

base_case.queue_model: M/M/1 distribution assumptions; empirical mean service capacity

assumptions.input_status: Commercial inputs are scenario assumptions, not supplier quotes or measured site costs. Simulation-derived inputs are loaded separately from final validation.
notes: A section is one 6 x 4 m modeled bay, not one raster lane. The 504 m2/day workload is assumed and is not inferred from an electrical 100 kWp model.
Manual labour price cancels under normalization; no real currency amount or verified commercial saving is claimed.
Repeated independent attempts after failure, human recovery and between-bay transfer are business assumptions; the simulator does not demonstrate autonomous between-bay movement.
M/M/1 assumes Poisson arrivals and exponential service. Measured service capacity calibrates the mean, not these distribution assumptions.
No electrical PV-yield or power-restoration percentage is inferred from dust mass or coverage. Discounting, financing, tax and coating damage are outside this simple-payback scenario.
Base case conservatively counts all assumed inter-bay transfer and recovery time as direct human labour; supervision fraction applies only during the robot attempt.

excluded_claims: 140000 kWh/year in Mumbai not independently established here
16% monthly soiling does not equal 16% annual yield loss
15.2% electrical power restoration and 8.6-month payback are not results of this simulation
uncertainty: Initial pose/soil/tilt trial uncertainty and commercial scenario uncertainty are separate; no claim that N simulation trials establish field reliability.
status: PROVISIONAL SINGLE-RUN SCENARIO; final Monte Carlo calibration pending
